tasks.task_description: Scan project root directory structure to identify modules and build files
Examine build.gradle.kts files for KSP dependencies and processors
Search for RPC-related source files and interfaces
Identify generated code directories and artifacts
Analyze RPC execution and routing mechanisms
Document RPC system architecture and data flow
Summarize findings in organized bullet points

description: Comprehensive analysis of RPC system components and KSP code generation in Autogenesis project
context: Found key RPC-related modules: rpc-ksp (KSP processor), server, server-extend, and sharedModel. The project structure indicates a comprehensive RPC system with code generation capabilities.

Analyzed build files: rpc-ksp is a KSP processor with symbolProcessingApi dependency. Both server and server-extend use KSP plugin and reference rpc-ksp as processor via 'add("ksp", project(":rpc-ksp"))'. They use Ktor for web server functionality and kotlinx-serialization for JSON handling.

Located KSP processor implementation: RpcProcessor scans for @RpcMethod annotations on suspend functions, generates registration code for RPC handlers. It supports typed payloads, streaming (Flow), and different directions (BOTH, etc.). Generates files like "Generated{ClassName}RpcBindings.kt" with registration functions.

Found generated code in build/generated/ksp directories. KSP generates registration functions like registerGameRpcHandlers() that bind @RpcMethod annotated functions to RpcRegistry. Server uses Ktor WebSockets with RpcRegistry for routing. RPC handlers are objects with suspend functions annotated with @RpcMethod specifying name and direction.

Analyzed RPC execution and routing: RpcRegistry dispatches requests to handlers based on method names and directions. RpcInvoker manages outbound calls with timeouts and streaming. System supports unary calls, streaming (Flow), notifications, and bidirectional communication. Uses kotlinx-serialization for JSON encoding/decoding. WebSocket transport layer with Ktor integration.

RPC System Architecture: 1) Developers annotate suspend functions with @RpcMethod 2) KSP processor generates registration code 3) Server initializes RpcRegistry and registers handlers 4) Ktor WebSocket receives messages 5) RpcRegistry routes to appropriate handlers 6) Responses sent back via WebSocket. Data flow: Client -> WebSocket -> RpcMessage -> RpcRegistry.dispatch() -> Handler -> Response -> WebSocket -> Client. Supports streaming, timeouts, cancellation, and bidirectional communication.

Completed comprehensive analysis of RPC system components and KSP code generation in Autogenesis project. All major components identified and documented including processor implementation, generated code, runtime infrastructure, and execution flow.
